name: Pattern Strategy
description: Bridge Pattern Strategy HTTP-exposed tools into OpenClaw agent tools.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the Pattern Strategy tool bridge service.

chartBaseUrl.description: Base URL for generated Pattern Strategy chart image downloads.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for remote tool calls.

asyncPollSeconds.description: Polling interval for deterministic Pattern Strategy async watches. This is code-driven and does not invoke an LLM.

tradingPrinciples.description: User trading experience and risk-control principles that are injected into every fresh/actionable signal enrichment callback. These principles guide final interpretation only and do not replace formal strategy signals.
